name: wake
notes: STARTUP SHOWPIECE, played once when the demo opens. CHOREOGRAPHY, and honest as such: it shows the arm's real verified range at a speed a person can watch, and implies no capability it does not have. LOOKS LIKE: the arm unfolds and rises high (joint3 sweeps 55 deg, the big one), reaches out and extends the forearm (joint4 out to -45), then looks around WITH ITS WRIST — joint5 and joint6 roll +/-25-30 deg each way, like a head turning, since the base cannot. It stretches to full extension, closes the jaws in a deliberate articulation, opens them, and folds back down. Peak 24 deg/s. JOINT1 IS ZERO IN EVERY WAYPOINT. Operator instruction at the arm: there are clamps on the sides of the base, so the base does not turn — the collision model cannot see those clamps, so the person standing there is the authority. hw_backend refuses any stream moving joint1 more than 2 deg. All expressiveness is joint2-joint6 plus the jaws. Positions are OFFSETS from whatever pose the arm is resting in. Full-range revision, authorized 2026-08-30 ('i want you to fully use the arm not just slightly move it'); budgets are measured with arm/measure_range.py and every stream is MuJoCo self-collision-verified before a frame is sent.
